title: Swarm Task Graph
description: Contract between the Architect agent and the swarm orchestrator. Defines tasks grouped into dependency waves with exclusive file ownership.

runId.description: Unique identifier for this swarm run, format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH-MM-SS_slug

specSource.description: Path to the spec file or 'inline' if description was provided directly

wave.description: Wave number, executed sequentially. Tasks within a wave run in parallel.

taskId.description: Unique task identifier, e.g. T1, T2, T3

title.description: Short title for the task, used in branch names and logs

description.description: Detailed description of what this task implements

fileScope.description: Exhaustive list of file paths this task is allowed to create or modify. Glob patterns allowed (e.g. src/Pricing/Tests/*.cs). No two tasks in the same wave may have overlapping file scopes.

verificationCriteria.description: Concrete, automatable criteria. Each should be verifiable by running a command or checking a condition.

dependsOn.description: Task IDs that must complete before this task can start. Tasks with dependencies MUST be in a later wave than all their dependencies.

baseCommit.description: The commit this task's worktree is created from. Recorded at dispatch because it cannot be inferred later: a task in a later wave forks from the previous wave's integration commit, not from the run's base branch. lib/check-scope.sh requires it to attribute changed files correctly.
